name: devkit
description: Command-gated skill packs, agents, and hooks for AI-assisted development: subagent-driven development, LangChain agents, LangGraph workflows, a documentation methodology, UI/UX design driven by the bundled Dolle-MCP server, web performance (Core Web Vitals), UI design fundamentals, prompt enhancement (clarify with AskUserQuestion, then sharpen), and shipping to platforms — Docker containerization, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (CI/CD & IaC). Packs live in packs/ and are exposed on demand via loader commands so they never bloat startup context.
